meta.title: Automation: schedule, tools, logs, and incidents
meta.subtitle: Request 008 design preview. Tool-owned automation source; centralized Admin reports. Not implemented.

cards.title: Source ownership
items: A dedicated job keeps runner, plist, README, AGENTS, and Archify docs inside the tool repository under automation/model-refresh/.
Space-wide orchestration keeps its source in Admin automation/. Calling the incident reporter alone does not change ownership.
Both kinds write reports under ~/.agents/automation/<stable-job>/logs/. Report files are ignored; an optional README only points to source.

cards.title: Request to implementation
items: 008 identifies the Admin request and success criteria. Use the full Superpowers design, implementation planning, execution, review, and verification workflow before activation.
Each independent tool repository has a linked Development Space worktree. Request 008 uses admin/opencode-free-router_008 for model-tool code and its own automation.
Preserve the existing schedule and unrelated old-runner behavior until a reviewed migration resolves their continuity.

cards.title: Success and incidents
items: Success or cached results stay in local logs. Pending incidents can still be replayed.
Proposed ticket defaults: Fix / Automations & Runtime / Admin / Captured. Repeated failures append to an unresolved ticket.
Preserve human status and fields. Do not close tickets automatically. Incident grouping still needs a decision.

cards.title: Failure and recovery limits
items: Persist sanitized events before delivery. Keep pending events separate from log retention. Reconcile uncertain deliveries before retrying.
Lock contention records skipped_locked. Do not kill the running job.
This runner cannot detect its own absence. Missing-run alerts need a separate observer.
Unattended Notion delivery is not installed. Chat connector access does not prove background credentials work.

cards.title: Evidence and readiness
items: Scheduled jobs call the stable tool checkout with an explicit Admin report root. Fixture and worktree runs use temporary reports and fake state.
Each report identifies run, job, request, source revision, and dirty state. Dispatch success is not proof of completion.
This preview is proposed. Notion grouping, unattended authentication, and live activation remain unresolved. Skill drafts are not installed.
